title: CP6 ALL open-document semantic crosswalk
review_kind: Bounded contract-to-source semantic mapping; no native execution; not complete implementation proof

persistence.method: Lead-authorized direct GitHub contents API; local exec/apply_patch unavailable
persistence.scope: Only the two named audit documents; no product files, other branches or workflows.

scope_boundary: M:1694/P:1126 places broader domain UI connections at CP7, without moving CP6 backend reliability. M:1697,1757 makes full accessory/laundry CR selection conditional. CP7 business-report addendum is a later reporting boundary, not an ALL-import implementation oracle.
method: An admitted amount, PO header, physical position or template name proves only that representation. Native continuation requires the actual source identities and lifecycle state consumed by its command. Missing locator means UNMAPPED, not a product defect. No owner private data, writer docs or PASS counts used.

rows.state: Received, not yet invoiced; some material may already be consumed
rows.representation: UNINVOICED_RECEIPT plus optional on-hand MATERIAL/MATERIAL_ROLL source and OPENING_COST_ORIGIN to WIP/BS/FG; creates native POSTED material_purchase_headers/items and private original receipt registry. Quantity is remaining uninvoiced quantity; price starts ESTIMATED. Opening stock occurs once.
rows.continuation: erp.post_material_supplier_invoice(uuid) can consume imported purchase_item_id; erp.post_supplier_payment(uuid) settles resulting payable. Supplier-return source validation accepts the imported purchase/roll lineage and caps return at on-hand opening quantity.
rows.boundary: Does not import old supplier invoices/payments or reconstruct earlier raw-stock consumption. Return posting entry point and complete public invoice/payment UI chain were not re-reviewed.
rows.next_evidence: Import receipt 10 units at 2, on hand 3 and consumed origins 7; invoice at 2.50, pay, return only physical eligible stock, reverse in dependency order; reconcile GRNI/AP and all destination costs.

rows.state: Already invoiced supplier debt, partly paid before cutover
rows.representation: Numbered OPENING_BALANCE_ITEM/SUPPLIER_PAYABLE with original_amount minus settled_before_cutover equals outstanding; immutable financial-source registry plus opening_subledger_balances. No native invoice lines created.
rows.continuation: erp.post_opening_subledger_settlement(uuid); PREPAYMENT/APPLY targeting OPENING, then corresponding linked reversal.
rows.boundary: Monetary settlement only. Old purchase quantity, invoice match allocations, return credit allocation and historical payment reversal rights are not carried by this representation. Complete general cash-settlement public create/UI route is unmapped.
rows.next_evidence: Original invoice 100, historically paid 35: import 65 only; settle 20 and inverse; prove payable 45 then 65 without historical receipt/invoice/cash journals.

rows.state: Receipt partly invoiced and partly still unbilled
rows.representation: Potential split: numbered billed outstanding under SUPPLIER_PAYABLE and separately identified uninvoiced receipt quantities/origins. Summary AP or same normalized receipt/AP document number is refused; distinct numbered sources are not categorically refused.
rows.continuation: Billed slice follows opening settlement; unbilled slice follows new native supplier invoice. No automatic reconstruction of original invoice-to-receipt allocation was mapped.
rows.boundary: Accounting/quantity reconciliation for the split is unproved. A distinct identifier is not permission to duplicate the same economic source.
rows.next_evidence: One receipt of 10 with 4 already invoiced and 6 unbilled: derive the two nonoverlapping obligations, physical/origin quantities and payments, then prove the combined controls without duplicate AP/GRNI.

rows.state: Unreceived purchase commitment or unfinished procurement draft
rows.representation: No dedicated purchase-order or purchase-draft import representation mapped. OPEN_PO is a production-order header, not a procurement order.
rows.continuation: UNMAPPED for retained pre-cutover commitment/version. Creating a fresh ordinary document is not proof of migration.
rows.boundary: No global unsupported-feature or defect claim. Need contract-relevant old document state and an authoritative adapter or explicit cutover rule.
rows.next_evidence: Define an unreceived purchase order and a partially received draft at cutover; map remaining quantity, original identity, approval and cancellation without receiving stock again.

rows.state: Posted old sales invoice with unpaid receivable
rows.representation: Numbered CUSTOMER_RECEIVABLE with original/prior-paid/outstanding provenance; opening_subledger_balances, not sales_headers/items.
rows.continuation: erp.post_opening_subledger_settlement(uuid), or PREPAYMENT/APPLY to OPENING; linked settlement/payment reversal.
rows.boundary: No historical revenue/COGS/cash replay. Opening AR does not establish original sale quantity, price, lot allocation or sales-return eligibility.
rows.next_evidence: Import invoice 100 less historical receipts 30; collect 25 and reverse; reconcile AR 70 to 45 to 70 with no duplicated revenue/stock.

rows.state: Sales draft with official reservation at cutover
rows.representation: Catalog carries FG stock and financial balances but no sales draft/item/reservation/allocation import. Native reservations require actual sale/item/lot source lineage.
rows.continuation: Ordinary erp.save_sale_draft_v2 / erp.cancel_sale_draft_v2 and erp.post_sale exist; bridge from an already reserved old draft is UNMAPPED.
rows.boundary: Do not treat physical FG opening, AR opening or a new draft as proof of retaining an old reservation. Product defect not established by missing adapter locator.
rows.next_evidence: At cutover physical FG 10 with old reservation 3; map official available/reserved facts, edit 3 to 2, cancel or post; prove stock changes exactly once and original draft identity remains explainable.

rows.state: Old sale return, customer credit or refund still open
rows.representation: Opening AR covers a positive debt; already-returned physical goods can have opening FG/BS position. Neither supplies native original sale_stock_allocations. No distinct customer refund-credit document adapter was mapped.
rows.continuation: erp.post_sales_return requires native active original sale, same customer, original FG lot and exact sale_stock_allocation_id; it cannot consume an opening AR balance alone. Alternate opening return/refund continuation is UNMAPPED.
rows.boundary: Do not relabel a refund liability as CUSTOMER opening advance without contract-supported classification. No claim that every alternative return/correction route is absent.
rows.next_evidence: Separate two fixtures: pending physical return from old invoice; already-received return with unpaid refund. Establish sale/lot/price/quantity rights or explicit opening adapter, then return/refund/inverse without revenue or stock replay.

rows.state: Recognized unpaid mandor payroll or reimbursement liability
rows.representation: Numbered CONTRACTOR_PAYABLE records remaining money and old document provenance; it does not create payroll_settlements, attendance rows or reimbursement entitlements.
rows.continuation: erp.post_opening_subledger_settlement(uuid) pays the opening liability. Ordinary approve_payroll/post_payroll_payment act on a separate real payroll and are not an automatic migration continuation.
rows.boundary: Reapproving old work after opening its payable requires explicit anti-double-accrual treatment. Work/period/rate/component/invoice allocation and public cash-settlement create route are unmapped.
rows.next_evidence: Recognized old wages 80 plus reimburse 20, paid 40: open/pay remaining 60 with no second wage/reimburse accrual; prove no old source can be paid again through a new payroll.

rows.state: Earned but unapproved sewing/attendance, unfinished component carry or unallocated reimbursement
rows.representation: Physical WIP/BS or contractor master does not establish historical work/attendance. Catalog has no work-card, person-day/period, component carry or BOM entitlement snapshot import.
rows.continuation: Native approve_payroll recalculates actual payroll and checks state; explicit pre-cutover source adapter or contract-sanctioned opening accrual policy is UNMAPPED.
rows.boundary: M:369-379 forbids fabricating past cutting/sewing/attendance/wages from opening WIP. Monetary total alone does not prove normal wage base, attendance allocation or GOOD-based reimbursement rights.
rows.next_evidence: Define separate old earned sewing, attendance period and GOOD/BOM reimbursement fixtures; retain unique source entitlement, partial payment and carry state, approve/pay/inverse with no synthetic historical production.

rows.state: Unused supplier, customer or laundry-vendor prepayment
rows.representation: OPENING_ADVANCE preserves party, dedicated account, original document/date, historical used/refunded amount and remaining advance; opening recognition does not replay cash.
rows.continuation: public.erp_save_initial_import_action_v1('PREPAYMENT',...): APPLY, REVERSE_PAYMENT, REFUND, CORRECT, REVERSE_EVENT. APPLY selects native post_supplier_payment/post_sales_payment/post_vendor_payment, or post_opening_subledger_settlement for target_kind OPENING.
rows.boundary: Money-only advance source; not an operational purchase/sale/laundry document. Mapping is not proof of date-prefix conservation, full target selection or concurrent availability; existing independent findings remain open.
rows.next_evidence: For each party import original 100, historical use/refund 30; apply 20, refund 10, correct and inverse with a dated event ledger, same-party target and exact cash/GL/subledger conservation.

rows.state: Old contractor cash advance reserved/deducted by future payroll
rows.representation: Numbered CONTRACTOR_RECEIVABLE with source_kind CONTRACTOR_CASH_ADVANCE; remaining receivable distinguished from accessory debt or penalty.
rows.continuation: public import ALLOCATE_CASH_ADVANCE -> erp.set_opening_cash_advance_payroll_v1 for existing DRAFT/CALCULATED/REVIEW payroll; erp.approve_payroll, erp.post_payroll_payment and erp.reverse_paid_payroll; amount zero releases reservation. Opening cash settlement is a separate backend path.
rows.boundary: Does not import old payroll/work; reserves availability only, and does not turn generic CONTRACTOR_RECEIVABLE into a payroll-compatible cash advance. Complete public cash repayment route not mapped.
rows.next_evidence: Import 70; reserve 30 against real eligible draft payroll, attempt cash settlement exceeding free 40, pay and reverse payroll, release; compare cash net, receivable and reservations exactly.

rows.state: Historical settlements and fully consumed old documents
rows.representation: settled_before_cutover is documentary provenance used to derive remaining amount. Historical native cash/payment rows and closed source histories are intentionally not reconstructed by opening import.
rows.continuation: Linked inverses operate on post-cutover payments/events generated by the new source; reversal of a historic pre-cutover payment is not mapped by this provenance field.
rows.boundary: ALL open-data scope is not an obligation to manufacture closed historical transactions. A newly discovered historic error needs an authorized opening correction policy; direct historic reversal is not implied.
rows.next_evidence: Prove historical settled amounts produce no cash event, cannot be double-counted as new payments, and a requested legacy correction uses an identified explicit source rather than a fabricated old transaction.

rows.state: Open production order header
rows.representation: OPEN_PO carries PO/model/contractor/target/status/current stage/start/notes. Finalizer calls apply_migration_open_pos; physical validator resolves production_orders. Header alone is not physical WIP or earlier production work.
rows.continuation: New ordinary domain work may use the PO; imported physical WIP/BS requires separate source rows. Full apply_migration_open_pos body and every subsequent work command were not re-reviewed in this pass.
rows.boundary: No inference of cutting groups, pickup manifests, size-level custody, payroll or laundry history from header stage/target.
rows.next_evidence: Import target 10 and a header only: prove no physical stock/work/wage. Add separately controlled 7 WIP + 3 BS, then prove closure/cancel waits for their disposition.

rows.state: Known physical SEWING or LAUNDRY WIP at cutover
rows.representation: OPENING_BALANCE_ITEM WIP with PO, size, whole PCS, source key, value, accessory_cost_included and contractor/vendor holder. Inserts INITIAL_IMPORT_WIP_OPENING stage position; allows only SEWING/LAUNDRY for physical WIP.
rows.continuation: public import WIP_OUTPUT -> erp.complete_initial_import_wip_v1 COMPLETE/REVERSE. COMPLETE creates linked PRODUCTION FG lot, QC_GOOD and stage-to-FINISHED event, accessory snapshot/accrual and HPP sync; no invented historical work.
rows.boundary: Attested good completion is the mapped continuation. A normal old pickup/distribution/laundry receipt cannot be inferred from the opening position. Current/dated capacity, inverse dependencies and costing still need independent runtime proof.
rows.next_evidence: Import 7 PCS valued 70, complete 3 then 4 with exact product/holder/date and accessory flags, test stale/concurrent completion and linked inverse; opening value transfers proportionally once, historical wages stay absent.

rows.state: Identified valued BS remaining at cutover
rows.representation: Physical BS with PO/product/size/stage/holder/PCS/value becomes native OPEN bs_case with LEGACY/UNKNOWN cause and explicit opening source link; value is carried in WIP.
rows.continuation: Native bs_resolutions feed opening disposition valuation via sync_initial_import_bs_disposition_v1/sync_initial_import_bs_value_v1. A new valid rework_order can use erp.post_rework_completion and reverse_rework_completion; public BS action creation chain remains unmapped here.
rows.boundary: Initial cause is not fabricated. Opening BS does not reconstruct an already-running old rework order or its completed/payable components. Runtime scrap/rework remainder valuation not accepted by source mapping.
rows.next_evidence: Import 5 BS valued 50; scrap 2, rework 3 with GOOD+BS=sent, then reverse permitted disposition; reconcile remaining quantity/value, expense, FG and later invoice variance once.

rows.state: Cut pieces awaiting pickup or unfinished cutting group at cutover
rows.representation: OPEN_PO header exists; physical WIP validator explicitly rejects CUTTING stage. MATERIAL_ROLL represents material stock, not a completed cut-group/size/pickup allocation.
rows.continuation: UNMAPPED for retained old cutting group and pickup remainder; importing as SEWING would need truthful contract-supported custody/stage evidence, not a relabel.
rows.boundary: Confirmed restriction of this physical WIP import, not a defect by itself: the detailed WIP extension names SEWING/LAUNDRY. Need explicit ALL cutover treatment for a real unfinished cutting obligation.
rows.next_evidence: Define cut-but-unpicked PCS and residual roll quantity, then identify source mapping that permits remaining pickup without consuming fabric or recognizing cutting twice.

rows.state: Laundry delivery already away, failed attempt, pending claim or old receipt/invoice at cutover
rows.representation: LAUNDRY WIP records current vendor/PO/size/PCS/value; VENDOR_PAYABLE records remaining money. Neither creates the old delivery-line/receipt/attempt/claim/invoice identities in the inspected import path.
rows.continuation: Mapped balance continuation is WIP_OUTPUT or opening payable settlement. Native erp.post_laundry_receipt/public.erp_save_laundry_qc_action_v1 needs canonical delivery source; validate_laundry_receipt_line requires matching delivery_line_id. Old claim/attempt adapter is UNMAPPED.
rows.boundary: M:379 expressly avoids reconstructing unknown prior laundry/distribution history. Rich laundry service CR selection is separate; no assertion that all old delivery/claim histories must be fabricated to accept CP6.
rows.next_evidence: At cutover vendor holds 10, 2 already returned and 1 claimed missing: map only actual outstanding quantity plus claim and vendor debt; prove a real later return/claim settlement without a second send, charge or QC.

rows.state: Existing rework already dispatched, partly completed or carrying unpaid components
rows.representation: Opening BS can establish remaining native case; catalog has no rework order/component/dispatch/accessory decision or partial completion import.
rows.continuation: erp.post_rework_completion requires a native COMPLETED rework_order, exact GOOD+BS=qty_sent, accessory decision and native PO/product source. A new valid order is distinct from reconstructing old partly completed work.
rows.boundary: Old paid/unpaid component entitlement, residual custody and prior FG output linkage remain UNMAPPED. Financial CONTRACTOR_PAYABLE/VENDOR_PAYABLE may carry money but does not establish those sources.
rows.next_evidence: Define dispatched 5, returned 2 before cutover, component cost partly paid; preserve only remaining 3 and unpaid obligations, then complete/pay once without recreating the old 2 output or already-paid work.

rows.state: Company-owned accessory or pocket stock physically on hand
rows.representation: MATERIAL master and MATERIAL opening quantity/value/location; FABRIC MATERIAL_ROLL for pocket rolls. Canonical opening stock is a baseline, not a mandor issue or a withdrawal.
rows.continuation: New count-accessory note uses public.erp_save_accessory_issue_action_v1 SAVE_DRAFT/POST/REVERSE; pocket material REGISTER then POST/REVERSE through public.erp_save_pocket_fabric_action_v1.
rows.boundary: Stock opening does not confer old charge price, contractor debt, BOM reimbursement or ownership-transfer history. Supported location/custody-specific paths beyond plain stock were not fully reviewed.
rows.next_evidence: Open 10 count units at inventory cost 2, issue 3 at independently chosen charge price: one stock decrease and correct receivable; for pocket roll, withdraw then inverse with period expense and no mandor debt.

rows.state: Pre-cutover paid-mandor accessory note/debt and possible unused return
rows.representation: Numbered generic CONTRACTOR_RECEIVABLE can preserve money owed. It does not create contractor_material_issue_items, original charged quantities/prices, prior payroll deductions or return eligibility.
rows.continuation: Opening cash settlement is mapped. Native issue SAVE_DRAFT/POST creates a new issue; no opening old-note partial-return or payroll-material-deduction adapter was mapped.
rows.boundary: Do not use CONTRACTOR_CASH_ADVANCE for accessory debt or recreate an old charged issue from already-issued stock. Expanded accessory return/custody CR selection remains separate from baseline financial opening.
rows.next_evidence: Old issue 10, 4 already settled, 3 unused returned after cutover: identify original price/quantity/credit rights and opening debt source, then reconcile stock, debt and payroll without posting the old issue twice.

rows.state: Company service custody, quarantine/damaged/unreturned or recovered accessories
rows.representation: Import has location, material quantity/value and notes. It has no explicit ownership, condition, service-issue, physical-receipt/inspection, recovered-component source or return-credit fields. LOCATION allows general location categories including OTHER; whether a valid existing service/quarantine path supplies needed semantics is unreviewed.
rows.continuation: UNMAPPED for detailed old custody/inspection/recovery continuation. Known company stock may have baseline location quantity, but no full service/return semantics follow from that alone.
rows.boundary: Full accessory service CR scope is conditional. Unknown recovery valuation cannot be replaced with invented zero; pre-system baseline evidence is distinct from fabricated backdated issue notes. No absence/defect conclusion from catalog alone.
rows.next_evidence: After selecting scope, map distinct company-owned usable 5, quarantine 2, unreturned 1 and recovered unknown-value components; prove receipt and inspection do not double stock or create automatic contractor credit.

rows.state: Pocket fabric already withdrawn or an open optional allocation period
rows.representation: Remaining roll stock can open. Catalog has no pocket usage adjustment or active allocation-period pool import, and opening WIP creates no historical sewn-output sources.
rows.continuation: For genuine new events, public.erp_save_pocket_fabric_action_v1 POST/REVERSE and POST_PERIOD/CANCEL_PERIOD. Pre-cutover withdrawal/allocation-period continuation is UNMAPPED.
rows.boundary: Do not reissue fabric already withdrawn or re-expense it to manufacture a pool source. Optional allocation is a later cost transfer, not another stock movement or a per-mandor free-pocket balance.
rows.next_evidence: Open remaining roll plus documented already-expensed withdrawal and a period spanning cutover; establish permissible source policy, allocate to valid sewn units including Afui, cancel/recompute and prove no duplicated stock/expense.

limits.native_execution: NOT_RUN for this crosswalk; source mapping does not clear existing runtime/source findings.
limits.all_acceptance: NOT_ESTABLISHED. No template count, writer PASS count or financial-control total proves full open-document continuation.
limits.source_review: Bounded listed lines only. Transitive helpers, final deployed definitions, every public caller/role, alternative legacy adapters and all domain UI paths are not exhaustively reviewed.
limits.cp7: Broader domain UI/reporting work remains separately scoped; no CP7 deferral of CP6 data integrity is inferred.
limits.source_oracle: Contract statements are normative; candidate bodies establish observed representations. Source comments are not independent oracles.
limits.persistence_blocker: Local exec/apply_patch transport failed. Exact candidate GitHub GETs supplied source reads; lead subsequently authorized persistence of these two completed audit documents through GitHub. No local-save claim.
limits.unperformed_work: All next_evidence scenarios, unmapped adapters/policies and incomplete caller/source chains are unperformed work, not tool-capability blockers.
limits.other_auditor: No other auditor report or branch was read.
limits.dev_source: AZ is a candidate supabase/dev family body; its source presence alone does not prove deployed definition.
